title: Audit
lead: Every request to Tuck leaves a record: who, what, when and with what result. Secret values never reach the log, and entries are linked in a hash chain, so after-the-fact edits show up immediately.

tiles.label: Summary
tiles.failingBad: delivery to a sink is failing
tiles.errorsBad: records did not reach the receiver

banner.title: No sinks
banner.text: This is a blocker for a bank. With no sink connected, secret access stays only in the primary Tuck log: there is no copy for SIEM or incident review.
banner.li2: Attempts to cross namespace isolation (403) never reach an external log
banner.li3: No data for a regulator report
banner.li4: Recommended: a rotating file and a webhook to SIEM

alert.title: A sink is not accepting records
alert.text: "{{name}}": {{count}} delivery errors. The primary log on disk is still written and nothing is lost, but the receiver does not see the records.

plate.title: Sinks
plate.empty: No sinks. No copy of the log is sent anywhere.

guard.title: Never switches off silently
guard.g1: The primary log with its hash chain is always written, regardless of sinks.
guard.g2: A sink failure never blocks a request, but it is counted and flagged here in red.
guard.g3: Deleting the last sink requires typing its name.

forbidden.title: Not enough rights to view audit
forbidden.text: The token does not allow reading audit sinks. The request was rejected, and the attempt itself has been logged.

error.title: Could not load sinks
error.message: The server did not answer or returned an error. The primary audit log is not affected.

drawer.title: New sink
drawer.hint: A sink receives a copy of every request Tuck handles, for compliance, SIEM and debugging.
drawer.name: Sink name
drawer.overwrite: A sink with this name already exists and will be updated.
drawer.timeoutHint: A sink that does not answer within the timeout counts an error, but the request is not delayed.
drawer.warn: Secret values are never written. Only the path, method, status and token fingerprint are logged.
drawer.errNameChars: Only a-z, 0-9 and hyphen, 2 to 32 characters
drawer.errPathAbs: The path must be absolute and start with /
drawer.warnHttp: An http:// address sends the log unencrypted. A bank needs https://.
drawer.syslogUnsupported: Syslog sinks are not available on this platform (Windows).

delete.title: Delete sink?
delete.message: This deletes the audit sink "{{name}}". Data already written stays on the receiver's side.
delete.last: This is the last sink. After deletion no copy of the log is sent anywhere. For a bank that is a blocker.

toast.stateFailed: Could not change the sink's state

live.todaySub: since 00:00 UTC · secret values are never written
live.title: Request log
live.gapNote: Some records were overwritten in the buffer before they could be sent — use a file sink export for the full history.
